{{Top|leg}}
'''Priority Transmission: Gold17012/X''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] communication from [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the Imperial Central Command on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The transmission detailed the flight plan of [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Empire Forever]]'' as it transited through the [[Essesia system]].<ref name="CCV">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=The Capture of Coh Veshiv}}</ref>
